shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them, with timestamps, hosts HugsLib's and Archotech Logs' log-window buttons in a suite-styled add-on tray, and can throttle runaway log spam. Plus a knowledge-base browser, in-game bug/fix reporting, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, impact scoring, content-fingerprint mod-change detection, and a public v2 API.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Version constant `1.3`; v1.2 is live on the Workshop (3771602203).**

### Governing rule: everything shown is a factual claim
This mod tells players which mod broke their game and whether a mod changed. People act on it.
- **Fail closed.** When evidence is incomplete, say nothing and say *why*.
- **A match string must be provably reachable from `Log`** — and "emitted by identified code", NOT "present in Assembly-CSharp". A ubiquitous framework mod counts as an emitter (see XML Extensions below).
- **Never re-derive an identity you already held.** Record the name/id when you observe it.
- **Never rank ourselves as culprit for an error we only reported.**
- **Never search or sort by a string you do not display.**
- **Never show a raw internal identifier to the player.** (Added after the ignored-issues audit below.)

---

## Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`, gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`. List (culled) + inspector + add-on tray. Toolbar B is a right-to-left cursor: Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, **Vanilla log** (only when a decorator is detected), search. Compat hint strip **frame-latched** (`_hintFrame`). Repeat chip shows `x{repeats}+{suppressed}`.

### Timestamps (`LogTimestamps`, setting `showTimestamps`, default ON) — VERIFIED LIVE
`Verse.LogMessage` **already** carries a private `timestamp` string, set to `DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss")` in BOTH constructors and rendered by its `ToString()`. Nothing exposes it, so `LogTimestamps` binds it once via `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess<LogMessage,string>` (allocation-free direct field read). Deliberately preferred over stamping messages ourselves from a patch on `LogMessageQueue.Enqueue`: no extra permanent patch, nothing to drift, and lines logged *before* our patches installed still have a time. Missing/retyped field ⇒ `Available` false, callers draw nothing — never an invented time.
- **Repeats carry the FIRST-seen time**, because `LogMessageQueue.Enqueue` folds a repeat into the retained message and only bumps `repeats`. The UI says "first seen HH:mm:ss" when `repeats > 1`, "logged HH:mm:ss" otherwise.
- Surfaces: fixed-width column in each list row (width measured from `"00:00:00"` so it never reflows as the clock ticks), right-aligned dim label on the inspector's type header, and a `Logged:` / `First logged:` line in `ReportBuilder.FullReport` — the report ignores the display setting, since "when did this start" is diagnostic data for someone who wasn't there.

### Log-window ownership + interop
- **HugsLib** — `LogWindowExtensions.AddLogWindowWidget` is the community hook. `LogWidgets` reflects its private `widgets` list and rebinds each `Drawer` via `Delegate.CreateDelegate` (not `DynamicInvoke`). Tray-hosted; throwing widgets dropped. `LogWidgets.Any` frame-latched (the tray sizes the body rect).
- **Archotech Logs** — `ArchotechBridge` hosts Diagnostics/Export. `Dialog_ArchotechInfoView(EditWindow_Log)` uses the host only for positioning and both consumers null-check it → **passing null is supported**. Its `DoWindowContents` reads the private **static** `EditWindow_Log.selectedMessage`, so `LogState.Selected` raises `SelectionChanged` and `ArchotechBridge` mirrors into that static.
- `yieldLogWindow` = full stand-down. Tray restyle: on-demand prefix on the 7-arg `Widgets.ButtonText` funnel, gated on `LogWidgets.Drawing`, control-count safe, honours `drawBackground:false`, fails open.

### `LogThrottle` — optional suppression of repeating lines (default OFF) — VERIFIED LIVE
`Log.Error/Warning/Message` evaluate `StackTraceUtility.ExtractStackTrace()` as an ARGUMENT, before `Enqueue` sees a repeat; below the cap of 99 every occurrence does a synchronous disk write; all inside `lock(logLock)`. **`LogMessageQueue` only combines with `lastMessage`** → dedupe is strictly consecutive; interleaved spam (A,B,A,B) never combines. Allocation-free FNV-1a + 64-slot ring; first `Threshold`(5) pass; 10s quiet window resets; `Environment.TickCount` (Log.Error can be off-thread); own short lock; fails open, latches off. Summaries drained from the `Root.Update` hook, never the prefix.
Run #444: 400 interleaved lines → 5 shown + summary `held back 395 repeats of a log line after the first 5`. Test fixtures in `DevActions/DebugActions_Testing.cs` under a "Modern Dev Tools" debug category (prefix `[Modern Dev Tools test] `, deliberately NOT the exact `LogPrefix`, so the synthetic errors still attribute to us). **These ship** — they double as player-facing demos of the glossary / benign-line / throttle features.

---

## Attribution pipeline
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`. 13 modules in `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`. `RankedMods()` cached, invalidated by `Merge`.

**`LogAnalysis` fills `Frames` from `LogMessage.StackTrace`** — for a `Log.Error(text)` call that is the stack of the CALLER, not of whatever threw. This is why self-report suppression is necessary.

- `Module_StackTrace` — frames → owning assembly; falls back to `NamespaceRoot` (only when exactly ONE loaded mod declares that root; `FrameworkRoots` blocks IL-merged `System.*`/`Newtonsoft.*` claims). **Skips self-attribution when the message starts with `ModernDevToolsMod.LogPrefix`.**
- `Module_LogPrefix` — `[ModName]` tags via `MatchTag` (unambiguous + ACTIVE only). **Strips Unity rich-text markup first.**
- `Module_MessageMentions` — the three vanilla `Mod X …` grammars (GREEDY captures), packageId tokens, mod folders in paths.
- `Module_HarmonyPatches` — reverse index of patched methods → owner ids; conflict claim needs ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace.
- `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_Community`, `Module_Glossary`, `Module_CircinusCorpus`, `Module_ReflectionBridge`.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > KnownIssues n−i (benign +1000). Context-only modules must score **< 1**.

### `IssueScoring` — ONE matcher for four knowledge surfaces
Weights (ExceptionType 3 / Regex 3 / Keyword 2 / Namespace 2 / PackageId 2) shared by the shipped library, mod-shipped files, API sources and the community DB. Allocation-free `OrdinalIgnoreCase` `IndexOf`. `RegexOptions.Compiled` deliberately dropped in the shared compiler (Mono Reflection.Emit, never reclaimed); FrameParser keeps it.

### Ignore keys are not all KnownIssueDefs — FIXED
`ErrorDiagnosis.Source` doubles as the ignore key. It is a `KnownIssueDef` defName for library entries, but a **module identifier** (`MDT_Module_*`) for module-raised diagnoses and `community:<id>` for community entries. Both settings surfaces fell back to printing the raw string, so ignoring a version-mismatch or community diagnosis put a bare `MDT_Module_VersionMismatch` in the player's settings list — reads as a broken translation. `ModernDevToolsMod.IgnoredLabel(key)` now resolves KnownIssueDef → ErrorModuleDef (handling `Module_CircinusCorpus` reporting `MDT_Module_CircinusCorpus` while its def is `MDT_CircinusCorpus`) → `MDT_IgnoredCommunityEntry` → raw, with the raw key moved to a tooltip. Shared by `SettingsPage` and `Dialog_Modules` to hold the parity contract.

---

## Correctness audit — 2026-11, four passes + live validation (runs #232, #444, #446)

### 1. Mod-change detection — REWRITTEN (`ModFingerprint` + `ModChange`)
**Reported bug:** a mod last updated in January flagged **updated**. Root cause: the token was `Directory.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(RootDir).Ticks` — not a content measure in either direction. A directory's write time changes when a *direct child entry* is created/deleted/renamed (Steam re-downloading identical bytes, verify-integrity, library moves, copies, restores) and does **not** change when a file deep inside is edited. Steam stamps the **local download time**, never the publish date.

Four further defects in the same 90 lines: `token = ""` on stat failure then compared to a real value; `NameOf()` re-derived names via `GetModWithIdentifier(pid, ignorePostfix:true)`, keyed on the **stripped** id (any `_steam` id → null) and otherwise returning `ElementAtOrDefault(0)` = the **local** copy; `d[pid] = token` last-writer-wins with `_steam` making `PackageId` unstable; comparer lost across Scribe.

**Now:** FNV-1a 64 over the sorted list of (relative path, file **length**) for every file under the mod's roots. **No timestamps**, so re-downloads/copies/restores/library moves reproduce the same hash. Low-priority background thread from `Bootstrap`; depth-capped at 24 (mod folders are often symlinks); excludes `.git/.svn/.hg/.vs/.idea/obj/bin/node_modules`; 40k files/mod. Unreadable dir or over budget ⇒ **UNKNOWN, never a guess**. Official Ludeon content is presence-tracked only.
- Keys `_steam`-normalized; local+Steam copies hashed **together**.
- The display **name is recorded in the save** from the loaded `ModContentPack`.
- Versioned (`mdtSnapshotVersion` + `mdtModSnapshotV2`).
- **Updated** requires BOTH fingerprints known and different; otherwise `Unverified`, shown as a footer.
- Deferred completion via `ModChange.TickPending()` on the permanent `Root.Update` postfix.
- **Legacy fallback:** the pre-1.3 `mdtModSnapshot` node is read on LOAD ONLY (guarded so it is never written back). Ticks discarded, KEYS kept → added/removed still works in `PresenceOnly` mode, structurally incapable of claiming "updated".
- Setting `detectModChanges` (default on), General card.
- **Accepted limit:** an edit preserving every file's exact byte length is invisible. Deliberate.

### 2. Self-attribution — FIXED (found live, run #232)
A Harmony **finalizer always appears in the trace of the exception it reports**. Vehicle Framework's `SmashTools.DetachedMapComponentCache` threw `KeyNotFoundException`; `HardeningPatches.MapBefore_Finalizer` caught and reported it. Because `Frames` comes from the *caller's* stack, the ONLY frames present were ours → we ranked first, the tool blaming itself for the bug it just caught. Fix: `Module_StackTrace` skips self when `ctx.Text` starts with `ModernDevToolsMod.LogPrefix`. A genuine unhandled exception in our code is logged by the ENGINE without that prefix and still attributes normally. **Every internal `Log.*` call must keep that prefix.**

### 3. Third-party knowledge files could claim another mod's error — FIXED
`Module_ModIssues` scored every `About/known-issues.json` entry against every error at the **highest score in the scale** (9+). One mod shipping `"keywords": ["NullReferenceException"]` would take the top slot for every unrelated error. `RemoteIssue` now carries `OwnerPackageId` + `HasExplicitScope`; a shipped entry applies only when the error implicates its owner, or it names its own packageIds/namespaces. API-registered sources exempt. **Documented** in `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md` → Path 1 → "Scope: your file answers for *your* mod".

### 4. Wrong-copy attribution in `InstalledModIndex` — FIXED
`ByName`/`ByFolder`/`ByPackageId` were first-writer-wins, so a stale **inactive** local copy could win a key — and `Module_VersionMismatch` then reads **its** About.xml, producing a false "does not support 1.6". `Put()` prefers the ACTIVE mod.

### 5. Lazy regex truncated mod names — FIXED
The three vanilla `^Mod (.+?) …` grammars stopped at the FIRST literal occurrence, yielding a truncated name matching no installed mod. Now greedy `(.+)` with the trailing literal anchored (4 sites).

### 6. Phantom match strings — and the rule that was too narrow
The 2026-08 audit verified strings **exist in Core**; the test that matters is **reachable from `Log`**.
- **`GetModWarnings()` output** (`ModsConfig.cs:513`) is consumed only by `Page_ModsConfig.cs:337`. **`MDT_Incompatible` removed** (all 5 keywords).
- **`loadErrors` lists** surface only in the translation report; the log gets a COUNT (`LoadedLanguage.cs:566`). `"tried to translate field"` → `"generate translation report for more info"`.
- Removed as non-existent: `"found no type named"`.

**`Module_DependencyCheck.MissingRefSignals` had never been audited.** 3 of 8 were phantoms, incl. `"could not find def named"`; the real string is `"Failed to find <Type> named X. There are N defs of this type loaded."` (`DefDatabase.cs:217`). OR-gate ⇒ silent false negatives. Rebuilt against verified call sites. **Confirmed live.**

**CORRECTION — the rule over-fired once.** `"failed to find a node"` / `"xpath"` were removed for not existing in Assembly-CSharp. Correct about vanilla, wrong about reality: **XML Extensions** (`imranfish.xmlextensions`) installs a `Finalizer` on ApplyWorker of all five vanilla pathed operations emitting `{Type}(xpath="{xpath}"): Failed to find a node with the given xpath`, intercepting patch failures for the WHOLE modlist. **Both restored.** Lesson: the emitter may be a ubiquitous framework mod.

### 7. Coverage gaps closed from live output
`MDT_UnknownType` +`"could not find a type named"`; `MDT_DuplicateDef` +`"has multiple"`; `MDT_MissingTexture` +`"collection cannot init"`/`"failed to find any textures at"`; `MDT_LoadReference` +`"null key while loading dictionary"`; `Module_LogPrefix` strips Unity rich text.

Defs: `KnownIssueDefs.xml` 42, `BenignLogDefs.xml` 5, `ErrorModules.xml` 13, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` 17.

### Known-remaining, NOT fixed
- **Lunar Framework side-loading blindspot.** Map Preview / Geological Landforms ship only `LunarLoader.dll`; real code is side-loaded from `Lunar/Components/` and is absent from `ModContentPack.assemblies.loadedAssemblies`, so `ByAssembly` and `BuildNamespaceRoots` both miss it. Fails **silent, not wrong**. A location-based fix must use a REDUCED weight and its own reason string: both mods ship the same `MapPreview.dll`.
- `Module_Community` uses `ModsConfig.IsActive(pid)` with community ids that never carry `_steam` → false negative only.
- Engine dicts use `CurrentCultureIgnoreCase`; we use `OrdinalIgnoreCase`. Turkish-locale divergence possible. **Unverified.**
- Two ACTIVE mods sharing a display name remain a coin flip in `ExactName`.
- `ModDependencyIndex` parity with `ModsConfig.FindConflicts` **unverified**.
- Uncovered grammars: `Parsed 1.5 as int.`, `[SafePatcher]The xPath: … not found`, texture/mask dimension mismatch, `has no resolvedGrains`.

## Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` banned except the dev palette's category line. Icons via `MdtTex`. Helpers: `SearchField`, `ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`/`DrawWell`/`DrawPlate`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `DrawCheck`, `ModuleRow`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`/`ResetGuiState`.
- Never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window`. Size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.
- **`DrawPlate`** gated to `Prefs.UIScale == 1f`. *Unverified at 125/150%.*
- **`BeginScroll` is re-entrant** (skin styles on a STACK). All scroll sites in try/finally; `ResetGuiState()` unwinds strays.

### Per-frame truncation was the big-modlist lag — FIXED (user report, 1000+ modlist)
**Reported:** the log window lags heavily right after loading a 1000+ modlist save; only while open; vanilla feels weightless by comparison. Root cause was NOT message count, analysis, or the filtered rebuild (all gated/cached — verified by inspection): it was `Palette.LabelFit`'s last-resort `GenText.Truncate(width)` **without a cache dict**. Vanilla's no-cache Truncate shrinks one char at a time, paying one `Text.CalcSize` + two string allocations per char removed. Big-modlist error lines are 150–300 chars against a ~550px column, so **every visible row ran a ~150–200-iteration measure loop every OnGUI pass** (~30 rows × 2–3 passes ⇒ >10k CalcSize + MBs of garbage per frame ⇒ Boehm GC storms). Short dev-test lines never trip the loop, which is why runs #444/#446 felt fine.
Fix: **`TextMetrics.Fit(text, width)`** — memoised ellipsis fit on the existing (text, width, font, fontSize, wrap) key; binary search (~8 raw CalcSize) on miss, dictionary hit steady-state; output matches vanilla's `"..."` shape; `Invalidate()` clears it. All three uncached Truncate sites routed through it: `Palette.LabelFit` (log rows + everything else), `Window_ModernDevPalette.LabelCategory` (palette is always on screen), `Window_ModernDevActions.DrawCell` (spawn grid). Also `Window_ModernLog.FirstLine` now caches per message via `ConditionalWeakTable` (was a fresh Substring per row per pass). **Not yet verified live on a big modlist.**

### Other performance notes from the same investigation (not yet addressed)
- `Window_ModernDevActions.DrawList` (list view) has NO viewport culling (grid view has it); `DebugTree.Children()` re-runs `VisibleNow` (mod delegates) + allocates a fresh List every OnGUI pass — scales with node count, worst in giant spawn grids. Candidate fixes: frame-latch the child list (also an IMGUI control-count-stability win), cull the list view, memoise `ThingForNode`, snapshot pinned paths per frame.
- Inspector draws the FULL stack-trace string through one `Widgets.Label` per pass — a 200-line Harmony-annotated trace is a real per-pass layout cost when selected. Candidate: split into lines once + per-line culling.
- Planned **step 2**: a shippable "UI cost probe" (Harmony wrap on `Window.InnerWindowOnGUI`, Stopwatch, avg + max-since-reset + passes/frame per window, Experimental card) to price our windows vs vanilla's on the same modlist; then **step 3**: verify on the user's real ~1000-mod list.

### Flat scrollbar — the disappearing-bar bug (FIXED, verified live)
Never a sizing bug — decompiled `UnityEngine.SliderHandler` confirms thumb height = `size*ValuesPerPixel() + ThumbSize()` where vertical `ThumbSize()` = `thumb.fixedHeight` or else `thumb.padding.vertical`, so the existing `padding = (0,0,12,12)` already floors the thumb at 24px.

**Real cause: texture lifetime.** The track/thumb/hover textures came from `SolidColorMaterials.NewSolidColorTexture` (no `hideFlags`) and were **locals**, their only surviving reference being `GUIStyleState.background`. `GUIStyle` is not a `UnityEngine.Object`, so `Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets()` cannot trace that reference and destroys the texture — and RimWorld runs that sweep via `MemoryUtility.UnloadUnusedUnityAssets()` on **every new game, save load and return to the main menu**. `_scrollInit` latched `true`, so nothing rebuilt them and the bar drew nothing for the rest of the session. "Big log" correlated only because a long log means a long session.

Fix: static `Texture2D` fields keep managed references, `HideFlags.HideAndDontSave` removes them from the sweep, and `InitScroll()` re-validates **every** `BeginScroll` using Unity's destroyed-object `== null` overload (a plain bool latch cannot detect this state). Generalises to any mod texture parked only in a `GUIStyle`.

### `TextMetrics`
Memoised `CalcHeight`/`CalcSize`/**`Fit`** keyed on (text, rounded width, resolved GameFont, fontSize, WordWrap). `Text.Font`'s getter returns the *coerced* font (Tiny→Small when `TinyFontSupported` is false). Cap-then-clear at 8192 per table. Main thread only.

## Tool 4: knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited. **Viewport-culled** — `BeginScrollView` clips pixels but doesn't skip draw code, so cards measure (memoised) but skip drawing outside a **frame-latched** window. Def counts cached. Glossary ~26 terms, `AllTerms()` cached.

## Tools 2/3: dev actions + palette
`Window_ModernDevActions` (3-tab, vanilla node graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search). `Window_ModernDevPalette` — resolved nodes cached against a hash of `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette`; pin/reorder sets `_pendingResizeFrame` applied a LATER frame (changing row count mid-frame shifts IMGUI ids).

### Spawn grid: displayed name vs defName — FIXED (user report, Medieval Overhaul)
**Reported:** base wood and Simple Research Bench missing while modded variants showed. User's hypothesis — "if something renames a base game resource it's not showing up" — was right about the mechanism.

Root cause is ours. Vanilla builds spawn nodes labelled with the **defName** (`DebugThingPlaceHelper` does `new DebugActionNode(localDef.defName, …)` in all five option builders). `DrawCell` upgrades the visible text to `def.LabelCap`, but `ActionSearchIndex` indexed `node.label` (the defName) and the order was vanilla's `TrySort()`, also by defName. **The grid displayed one string and searched/sorted by another.** `SimpleResearchBench` fails on the SPACES alone — reproduces in pure vanilla, which proves it is ours. Renaming a def just widens that gap.

Fix:
- `DebugTree.DisplayLabelFor(node)` — resolves to a `ThingDef` (via `ThingForNode`, which strips ` (minified)` / ` x50`) or a `PawnKindDef` (pawn spawn menus are built identically and had the same defect).
- `ActionSearchIndex` indexes node label **and** display label, and keeps a **squashed** form (letters+digits only) matched against a squashed needle — this is what makes "simple research bench" find `SimpleResearchBench`.
- `SortedByDisplay` orders the grid by the drawn label, memoised on (path, search, count) because the child list is rebuilt from the node graph every frame.
- Cell tooltip shows display label + defName on two lines.
- **`DrawThingIcon` had no fallback** when `Widgets.GetIconFor(def)` returned null — the cell came out completely empty, reading as broken. Now falls back to the neutral action glyph and treats `BaseContent.BadTex` as "no icon". (Likely hit by MO, which repoints `WoodLog`'s icon at `UI/IconWood`.)

**Field note:** Medieval Overhaul renames vanilla `WoodLog` to **"timber"** (`1.6/Patches/RawLogsRelatedPatches/Replace_WoodLog.xml` removes label/description/graphicData/thingCategories then re-adds them). No def named `WoodPlank` exists in MO — that string is only a texture path. Selecting a spawn entry arms a cursor tool (`DebugActionType.ToolMap` → `DebugTools.curTool`); the player must then click the map. Not a bug.

## Hardening + `HardeningPatches`
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, off by default. All 7 hardening patches, 3 throttle prefixes and the tray restyle install only while their feature is on. **One permanent patch: postfix on `Verse.Root.Update`** driving `SyncIfNeeded()` + `LogThrottle.DrainSummaries()` + `ModChange.TickPending()`. Apply MUST happen there, never from the settings UI (which runs *inside* two targets). Failures latch `_broken`. **Confirmed working live** (run #232).

## Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json. `LogAnalysisCache.Clear()` raises a volatile `_dirty` flag; swap on next main-thread read.

## Public API v2 (`ModernDevToolsAPI`) — frozen contract
`ApiVersion = 2`. v1: `RegisterModule`, `Invalidate`. v2: `RegisterKnowledgeSource`, `RegisterLogWidget`, `AnalysisCompleted`, `ModernOwnsLogWindow`, `IsModernLogOpen`, `OpenModernLog()`, `YieldLogWindow()`. Reflection-bindable; `LogWidgetDrawer` signature-identical to HugsLib's `WidgetDrawer`. No signature changed in 1.3; the `known-issues.json` scoping narrowing is documented under Path 1.

## Settings surfaces — parity contract
`SettingsPage.Draw` canonical superset; `Dialog_Modules` quick subset. Cards: Log window (incl. `showTimestamps`), Log spam, General (incl. `detectModChanges`), Modules, Ignored, Community, Experimental hardening. `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

## Testing / environment notes
- Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.
- Run #232: real ~910-mod list, ~75 error classes, exactly one attributed to us (hardening *reporting* Vehicle Framework's exception → fix #2). Save load failed upstream in Worldbuilder's `Faction_Name_Patch.Postfix`.
- Runs #444/#446: isolated sessions (Core+DLCs, then +Medieval Overhaul via `companionMods`). Scrollbar, timestamps and throttle all confirmed. Only foreign error was vanilla Ideology's `NamerDeityChristian` rule pack exhausting its five deity names at worldgen.

## 1.3 RELEASE PREP — done (pre-perf-fix state)
- Version constant `1.3`; About.xml supportedVersions `1.6`; PublishedFileId `3771602203`; `About/Preview.png` present.
- All XML well-formed; 351 keyed strings, no duplicates; every `.Translate()` key resolves (the six unmatched greps are GUI control names and internal ignore-key identifiers, not translation keys).
- `MDT_UpdateNotesBody` extended with **Timestamps in the log** and a **Fixes** section (scrollbar, spawn-menu search/sort, empty icon tile). *(Consider adding the big-modlist lag fix to the notes before shipping.)*
- `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md` — outstanding TODO cleared (known-issues.json scoping).
- `Documentation/UI-Parity.md` — `showTimestamps` row added.
- Committed as `a0f6e5f`, 1 commit ahead of origin/main — not yet pushed. **The Fit/FirstLine perf fix is NOT yet committed.**

### Outstanding user actions before/at publish
1. **Push** to `Astryls/ModernDevTools` (now includes the perf fix once committed).
2. **Push `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/main/known-issues.json`** (regenerated from the audited `Data/community-bugs.json.gz`, 17 entries) to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`, or the opt-in fetch keeps overwriting good local data with bad.
3. Decide whether About.xml's `<description>` should gain a timestamps line (user-owned copy; not touched).
4. Steam upload of 1.3.

### Still unverified
**`TextMetrics.Fit` lag fix on a real big-modlist log (the reporting scenario)**; mod-change panel end-to-end; `ModFingerprint` cost on ~910 mods; v2 snapshot Scribe round-trip; `PresenceOnly` legacy path; self-report suppression in the log's own culprit ranking; mod-shipped-issue scoping; tray restyle; Archotech tray buttons; `DrawPlate` at 125/150% UI scale; the new `IgnoredLabel` fallback.
